question: Confirm or reject the 45 DNS-label vendor candidates (43 Foundant fcsuite.com, 2 Foundation Cloud spectrumportal.net; $0.66bn DAF assets) and the 42 unmapped CF homepages that refuse scripted reads, using first-party CF pages read by hand (WebFetch/browser), not vendor tenant pages; record label collisions
conclusion_affected: Foundant count share (46.3% high/medium in v2; up to 51.6% if all candidates hold); unmapped asset share 2.8%
rationale: A DNS hit under a non-wildcard vendor zone shows the tenant exists, not whose it is: bcf.fcsuite.com belongs to Bainbridge CF, not Baltimore. Foundant's robots.txt bars AI agents, so identity has to come from the CF's own site; of 12 hand-checked homepages that loaded, 7 linked a vendor portal and 5 showed no fund login

question: Find the general ledger behind the 9 Foundation Cloud (spectrumportal.net) fund-portal tenants still at low or no GL evidence (Tulsa $694m, San Diego $708m, Kalamazoo, Santa Barbara, Nevada, Amarillo, Montana, Frederick, Door County, NW Minnesota, Initiative Foundation; plus new tenants Greenville and Ventura) from audited-statement notes on system conversions, TY2025 990 Part VII-B and dated job postings
conclusion_affected: NPact vs Blackbaud ledger share; Foundation Cloud as portal-only layer
rationale: Every Foundation Cloud tenant with GL evidence (FFTC, GWCF, CFES, CFGP, San Diego) runs Blackbaud FE NXT under it. The 'spectrumportal.net => NPact ledger' rule now has no positive case; only Santa Barbara's Fusion Labs hosting line ($130k) leaves room for an NPact-hosted ledger
